a.lede: Why go through the hassle of reading a study for yourself when you can turn it into an AI agent and tell it to reproduce the analysis for you?
a.title: Scientific papers become agentic chatbots with new tool

b.lede: ChatGPT, Character.ai, and Snapchat’s My AI will all be in the crosshairs as the AI Kids Act aims to strip minor-facing chatbots of all the things that make people love them.
b.title: The EU Wants to Break Up Kids and Their Chatbots
